card.name: Small words before Murray River names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, and, of, at) just before a place name, mainly the Murray and Darling Rivers in an Australian wetland text. Also fires on first digits of years in biographical or history text.

modes.label: Linking word before river/place name
modes.description: The, and, of or at right before Murray, Darling or another proper place name in Australian geography text.

modes.label: First digit of a year
modes.description: The opening digit of a year in a short history or biography passage.
modes.example: a sonnet in The European Magazine. That same year he began attending St John's College, Cambridge, and received his A.B. degree in <<1>>791. He returned to Hawks

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward proper names, such as surnames and place names, rather than ordinary words.
card.plain: It fires on little words like "the" or "of" when a proper place name, such as the Murray River, is about to follow.
